availability_note: Same Sootopolis party (Rillaboom 36, Kartana 20, Flutter Mane 68, Zapdos 30 reachable legend, Raging Bolt 60, Incineroar 36); Sootopolis after the cavern and Cave of Origin, Rain Badge not earned, nothing from Ever Grande or the League.

attempts.note: T1 Slowking Protect blocked Fake Out + Leaf Blade while the AI swapped Relicanth for Overqwil's Intimidate. T2 Slowking chose Trick Room but Leaf Blade (2x) KOed it first; Overqwil's crit Barb Barrage did 277 to Rillaboom. T3 Grassy Glide did 243 to Relicanth, Crunch finished Rillaboom. T4 Flutter Mane's Thunderbolt took Relicanth; T5 Thunderbolt took Overqwil into Kartana's Protect. T6 Shadow Ball broke Cursola, Leaf Blade OHKOed Quagsire but Rocky Helmet finished the 27-HP Kartana; Cursola's Shadow Ball left Flutter Mane at 3. T7 Shadow Ball took Cursola while Avalugg's Wide Guard blocked Heat Wave; T8 two Thunderbolts beat Sturdy.

strategy_checks.check: Slowking sets Trick Room behind Mental Herb on turn 1-2
strategy_checks.evidence: T1 Protect (blocked a 2x Leaf Blade + Fake Out - correct), T2 chose Trick Room but a faster Leaf Blade KOed it. The setter was killed, so the room's concept never showed on the board; that is the crack line working, not an AI failure.

strategy_checks.check: Relicanth Rock Head Head Smash is the payoff
strategy_checks.evidence: T3 Head Smash into Rillaboom-slot after Rillaboom fainted (redirected, 'not very effective' on Kartana), T4 Head Smash 126 on Kartana; without Trick Room it always moved last and took a 4x Grassy Glide first.

strategy_checks.check: Cursola Perish Body / Strength Sap threat
strategy_checks.evidence: I attacked it only with Shadow Ball; it used Shadow Ball three times (one into a Protect, one that left Flutter Mane at 3 HP with a SpD drop). It never used Strength Sap on my physical attackers, which would have been the better click on T5-T6 against Kartana.
Entered T5, chose High Horsepower into Kartana on T6 and was OHKOed by a 4x Leaf Blade; Rocky Helmet chip took Kartana with it.
AI switched it in on T1 for the Intimidate; T2 crit Barb Barrage 277 on Rillaboom (not poisoned, so no doubling); Crunch KOed Rillaboom T3.

strategy_checks.check: Avalugg Body Press / Wide Guard closer
strategy_checks.evidence: T7 Wide Guard on entry blanked Heat Wave; T8 it was double-Thunderbolted through Sturdy before Body Press.

protect_ledger.payoff: REAL - blocked Fake Out + 2x Leaf Blade; partner slot switched to Overqwil (Intimidate landed).
REAL - blocked a 2x Heat Wave; Cursola died beside it anyway.

ai_defects.board: Cursola + Overqwil/Quagsire vs Flutter Mane (full) + Kartana (~50 HP, Protecting T5)
ai_defects.chosen: Shadow Ball at Kartana (T5, into Protect) then at Flutter Mane (T6)
ai_defects.better: T5 Shadow Ball at Flutter Mane (2x, the only target that was not Protecting) - it chose the battler that had just Protected the turn before. Low severity.

authored_set_legality: No problem found. Levels L84 x5, Avalugg L85; all six had 0 Speed IVs as authored (Relicanth and Cursola moved last every turn).
theme_note: Only half. The room is built on Trick Room and the setter died before the room went up, so what the board showed was six slow Waters being outsped - correct counterplay by the dossier's own crack line, but it means the concept is fragile: one Fake Out + one Grass hit on Slowking ends the idea. The Cursola-avoidance lesson did shape my play (I never made contact).
level_changes_unverified: No changes (won with 2 faints after a real fight).
cooler: The concept is right but too easy to decapitate: Slowking with a Focus Sash or Eject Button, or a second Trick Room user (Cursola learns it), would let the reversal actually happen against a Fake Out lead. Not changed in this pass.
most_worth_rerunning: Rerun without a Fake Out lead to see the room under Trick Room at least once.
